title: RADIUS Flex Soft Toothbrush Right Hand Black

comparisons.notes: Variant Single / Right / Black, SKU SRB-056, barcode 085178002223; in stock per the store's product data

writeup: The RADIUS Flex Brush in soft bristles, right-hand grip and black is $5.90 on Woot, while RADIUS's own store charges $11.25 for the same single brush (SKU SRB-056). It has a flexible neck meant to ease pressure for hard brushers, over 6,500 plant-based bristles and the ADA Seal of Acceptance. Woot showed only 3 left with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Exact match by MPN SRB-056 and UPC 085178002223 (right hand, black, single)
